run_InferencePipelinePointMap: run the InferencePipelinePointMap pipeline to generate 3D objects from an image with optional pointmap input
run_compute_pointmap: run compute_pointmap to extract a pointmap tensor and intrinsics from an input image using the depth model
run_post_optimization: run post-optimization on a mesh GLB to refine rotation, translation, and scale using layout and pointmap data
run_post_optimization_GS: run Gaussian Splatting post-optimization to refine pose parameters using rendering optimization and occlusion checks
run_estimate_plane: run plane estimation from a pointmap dict and image to extract a ground plane mesh using Open3D
